Very nice and quiet place with excellent food
Aug 2025 • Couples
We walked past this place during the day and it looked so cozy and friendly, we immediately knew we wanted to come back here for dinner.

Our waitress was very kind and the cook (who I believe was also the owner) later came by to check if we liked the food and told us a little bit about the dishes we had and how they were prepared.

The dishes (homemade banana-noodles with chicken, and the salmon for me) were very delicious. Same goes for the cocktails!

I would definitely go here again!
